howto.what: 启用插件后自动运行:在会话开始和提交提示时注入项目静态规则,apply_patch 后按文件匹配注入对应规则;动态输出作为附加上下文注入并按插件数据会话去重,不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当你询问 Codex Rules 的行为、注入的项目规则、支持的规则文件位置、匹配方式或环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件路径?
say.note: 会列出支持的项目来源路径。

howto.what_en: Once enabled it runs automatically: it injects static project instructions on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and matching file-specific rules after apply_patch. Dynamic PostToolUse output is added as extra context, deduped per plugin data session; tool output is not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.
